newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds closed up but uncertain short-term.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds closed up but uncertain short-term.

text.p: UK meals and feeds closed firmer but with traders feeling uncertain over the short-term picture following the recent volatility seen on the Chicago soybean meal futures.
Soybean meal selling levels ended the day around four sterling per tonne firmer than Tuesday's finish.
"The only sector to show any interest at the moment is that for soybean meal, but we need prices to come down before that sector can realise any trade," one trader said.
"The rest of the market is completely lifeless," he added.
Rapemeal selling levels were completely unchanged from Tuesday's close.
